title: Mission Vidhya
metaDescription: Project Vidhya – Fight Against Illiteracy by Being Sevak Charitable Trust empowers disabled and underprivileged children through education, school kits, learning support and personal development.

content.description: Being Sevak Charitable Trust presents Project Vidhya – Fight Against Illiteracy, an initiative dedicated to empowering disabled and underprivileged children through education and personal development.

content.heading: Building Future Through
content.text: Our mission is to empower children from financially weak backgrounds by providing quality education support. From notebooks and school kits to awareness programmes and mentorship — we aim to create equal opportunities for every child.

content.title: Help Us Continue This Educational Mission
content.description: Your donation helps children receive books, school kits and access to learning opportunities.
